# distributed-cache-cluster

> Replicated in-memory cache cluster with consistent hashing, SWIM-style gossip membership, quorum reads and writes and rebalancing, tested under a seeded fault-injecting network simulator Maven artifact `io.github.trysac:distributed-cache-cluster`, Java package
> `io.github.trysac.distributed_cache_cluster`, MIT licensed, Java >= 21, standard library only.

- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the library and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
